description: GAP-1 (bean qou-5o0l, epic qou-xu6t): resolves the apparent tension between delta_lambda_qdim_route_probe (q-dim convention is a Rule-14 hidden DOF spanning 0.4×–5.6× of target) and #4399 (conjugation-symmetric Δ_λ ⇒ g₂ = 0, excluded). They compose: hook multisets are conjugation-invariant, so BOTH the balanced and unbalanced q-dimensions ([n]_q!/∏[h]_q, λ-independent numerator) are conjugation-symmetric and are excluded by #4399; the fake-degree / principal specialization carries q^{n(λ)} with n(λ) ≠ n(λ') for every λ ⊢ 6 except the self-conjugate (3,2,1), so it is covariant and survives. Hence exactly one of the three conventions survives the structural filter — the convention is PINNED by a proved invariant rather than chosen to fit, closing the hidden degree of freedom that made the magnitude route a fit trap. HONEST NEGATIVE: the surviving convention still fails as a universal magnitude — its own ℓ¹/target is 0.85 (D), 1.35 (T), 2.18 (³He), 5.62 (⁴He), a 6.6× spread across the chain. So GAP-1's outcome is genuine parameter-free structural SELECTION plus a scope-(a) negative on the magnitude; no closure, no convention adopted to fit, nothing wired.

convention_filter.verdict: convention PINNED by the #4399 structural filter (2 of 3 die on a proved invariant, not on taste) — hidden DOF closed; but the survivor still misses the magnitudes across the isotope chain (scope-(a)), so magnitude OPEN
